definitions: To become speechless or emotional, often to the point of tears, due to strong feelings.
To become unable to speak or perform effectively due to nervousness or pressure.
To make someone emotional or speechless.
To block or clog something, often partially.
examples: She started to choke up when talking about her lost pet.
The pressure of the final game made him choke up.
The sad story choked her up.
Leaves can choke up the drainpipe.
